Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 21%, 38% and 58% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished jade-green stone fused directly into her own form, natural cloudy veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface with VIVID pale-green vein striations. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
